accessions: GSE101820 (human muscle arrays, separate cohort, not analyzed here)
assay: bulk polyA RNA-seq, quadriceps (QA) and soleus (SOL), mouse, n = 3 per group (S4.11.p1)

factors.exercise: not a factor of the RNA-seq; exercise appears only in qPCR/western experiments (S2.5.p1, FIG4, Supplemental Figure 11)

sample_inclusion: 30 sequenced samples = 5 genotypes x 2 muscles x 3 mice; all sedentary/unexercised as described
primary_estimand: Effect of Cdk4/E2F3 genotype on muscle transcriptome (Cdk4 R/R vs WT in QA, FIG2D; Cdk4 KO vs WT in soleus, FIG3B; E2F3 mKO vs MLC-Cre in soleus, FIG5C). No exercise estimand is defined for the RNA-seq.
planned_contrasts: Cdk4 R/R vs Cdk4 WT, quadriceps (FIG2D-F; count not reported)
Cdk4 KO vs Cdk4 WT, soleus (FIG3B-C; count not reported)
E2F3 mKO vs E2F3 WT, soleus (FIG5C-D; count not reported)
Overlaps: 199 genes RR & E2F3mKO, 483 genes KO & E2F3mKO (FIG6A, FIG6D; DEGs at P < 0.05)
exercise_contrast: none in GSE185154; exercise effects (MyoD1, Pgc-1a, E2F3, p16) are measured by qPCR and western blot (S2.5.p1, FIG4A-C)
normalization: featureCounts, RPKM (S4.11.p1); GEO deposits FPKM only
paper_results: No DEG counts per contrast are given; overlap counts 199 and 483 (FIG6) use DEGs at P < 0.05
